spotify.note: Music and audio streaming (Stockholm; the firm lists the US office); Pär-Jörgen Pärson 'leading the first financing round in 2008 ... the A-round' (the firm's post 'Spotify - The Impossible Success Story', 2018-03-15), co-led with Creandum; NYSE since April 2018; market cap aligned to Tiger's freshest cited figure; the pre-filled 'acquired' (a Wikidata parent join) is disputed

spring-health.note: Precision mental health benefits (New York); the $22M Series A of Jan 2020 (the company's announcement, republished on the firm's site 2020-01-27; the firm lists Partnered 2020, Pär-Jörgen Pärson and Wendy Xiao); $3.3B in the $100M Series E of July 2024 (aligned to the siblings' cited mark), stale beyond 24 months

stepstone.note: Online job boards (founded in Oslo 1996); the firm lists Partnered 1997, round not named; StepStone ASA listed on Oslo Børs 2000 and was acq. by Axel Springer, 2009 (later HQ Düsseldorf)

sticky.note: Eye-tracking ad-testing SaaS, founded in Stockholm as EyeTrackShop (the firm's post 'Northzone invests in EyeTrackShop', 2012-05-15), later Sticky Ad, Inc. of San Francisco (Form D 2016, Jeppe Zink director); the firm marks it Acquired, the acquirer is not named on any surface read; the 2012 round is not named (a $3M raise in 2013, MrWeb), so the entry stage is undetermined; Menlo's row reads defunct (rule 10, raised at the alignment)

stockeld-dreamery.note: Plant-based cheese (Stockholm), Noquo Foods until 2021; the EUR 3.25M seed with Northzone and Creandum (EU-Startups, 2020-01); $20M Series A Sept 2021 (AgFunderNews); acq. by Bettani Farms, Dec 2025 (Green Queen), after the business had stalled; Creandum's row reads defunct (aligned at the ingest)

stonly.note: Interactive customer-support guides (Paris); Northzone led the $22M Series A with Accel (the firm's post, 2022-01-27); Accel led the EUR 3.2M seed of 2020

stream.note: Earned-wage access and workplace finance (London), Wagestream until 2025; Northzone co-led the GBP 15m Series A with Balderton (the firm's post, 2019-05-20; TechRound); the pre-filled defunct / IT is a one-word Wikidata join and is disputed; not Felicis's, YC's or Battery's Stream

sunscreen.note: Privacy engineering tools (sunscreen.tech); the firm lists Partnered 2022 and Wendy Xiao, round not named; the city is not given on the surfaces read

supponor.note: Digital billboard replacement for live sports broadcasts (founded in Finland; the firm lists the UK); the firm lists Partnered 2008 and marks it Acquired, round and acquirer not named on the surfaces read

tana.note: Notes-to-actions workspace (Oslo); the firm lists Partnered 2021 and Jeppe Zink, round not named; Lightspeed's row enters a later round

tandem-health.note: AI clinical scribe (Stockholm); Northzone led the $9.5M seed with Amino Collective (the firm's post, 2024-06-19); $50M Series A July 2025 (tech.eu), $100M Series B Sept 2026 led by EQT's Scaleup Europe fund

thirty-madison.note: Consumer healthcare brands (Keeps; New York); the $15.25M Series A of Oct 2018 (Business Wire, linked from the firm's post 'Our investment in Thirty Madison', Paul Murphy); valued above $1B in the $140M Series C of June 2021; acq. by Remedy Meds, Sept 2025 ($500M deal, MobiHealthNews); First Round's row enters the same company

tier.note: Shared e-scooters (Berlin); the firm lists Partnered 2018, the year of Tier's Series A after Point Nine's seed; Tier merged with Dott in 2024 and the combined company operates as Dott (the firm's page links ridedott.com and marks it Acquired): the business continues in the merged private company, aligned with Point Nine's private; the pre-filled 'acquired 2012' is a one-word Wikidata join, disputed

tobii.note: Eye-tracking technology (Stockholm, founded 2001); the firm lists Partnered 2009, round not named; Nasdaq Stockholm since 2015, small cap

topline-pro.note: Done-for-you marketing for home-service SMBs (New York, YC); Northzone led the $27M Series B (the firm's post, 2025-08-14), its first investment

troop.note: Collective shareholder activism for everyday investors (founded in Brooklyn); Northzone co-led the $4.3M seed with BlockTower and Seedcamp (the firm's post, 2022-11-02)

truelayer.note: Open-banking payments network (London); the firm's post 'Our investment in TrueLayer' (2018-07-19) announces its first investment, the company's Series A after Connect Ventures' 2017 seed; the 2021 $1B unicorn mark is superseded by the 2024 down round (aligned to Tiger's cited reading below $1B)

trustpilot.note: Consumer review platform (founded in Copenhagen; LSE-listed, London HQ since the 2021 IPO); Northzone's first money was the 'initial capital injection from SEED Capital Denmark and Northzone in November 2011', the round before the $13M Series B of 2012 (Wikipedia, Trustpilot): the Series A by the record's own sequence; market cap GBP 796.7M @ ECB 2026-09-29 (GBP/EUR 0.85718, EUR/USD 1.1355) = $1.06B (StockAnalysis), within 6% of the $1B edge

tuza.note: Card-payment provider comparison for SMBs (London); the firm lists Partnered 2023; a GBP 4M seed of May 2024 (FinSMEs) is later than the firm's year, and Northzone's round is not named

unobravo.note: Online psychotherapy (Naples); Northzone co-led the growth round with Insight Partners and H14 (the firm's post, 2023-12-13; Startupbusiness: CDP VC out, Northzone and H14 in), its first investment

videoplaza.note: Video ad serving (founded in Stockholm; London office); the EUR 5M round of 2010 led by Creandum and Northzone, the round after Creandum's 2008 seed (Creandum's row and posts; 'Videoplaza secures five million in funding', the firm's archived post 2010-03-18): the Series A by sequence; acq. by Ooyala, Oct 2014

wallapop.note: Second-hand marketplace (Barcelona); the firm lists Partnered 2015, round not named (Wikipedia: investors include Mangrove, Northzone and Eight Roads); Naver took 100% in Aug 2025 at a EUR 600M valuation (bebeez), so acquired; Accel's row still reads private (aligned at the ingest); Wikidata ES confirmed

xbow.note: Autonomous AI penetration testing (founder Oege de Moor, ex-GitHub); Northzone co-led the $120M Series C of March 2026 (the firm's post), its first investment; Bloomberg 2026-03-18: valued at more than $1 billion (the figure is the floor the report states)

yonder.note: UK challenger credit card (London); Northzone co-led the GBP 20m seed with LocalGlobe (the firm's post, 2022-03-31); the pre-filled US country is a one-word Wikidata join and is disputed; not Lux's Yonder (Austin, security)

yope.note: Private social app for Gen Z (Kyiv-founded, the firm lists the UK); Northzone led the $12.3M round of July 2026, which the record calls 'Pre Series A' (FinSMEs, 2026-07-23) and TechCrunch only 'raises $12.3M': the word straddles Seed and Series A, so it dates the entry and names no stage (Balderton R5); an earlier $4.65M round at $50M (ain.ua, 2025-02-25) had no Northzone

zeal.note: Self-custody crypto wallet and card (founded by ex-Revolut staff; The Block, 2023-11-21); the firm lists Partnered 2021 and the UK; no round naming Northzone found on the firm's posts or in press, so the stage is undetermined; the pre-filled JP is a one-word Wikidata join, disputed; not the San Francisco Zeal of Spark and YC (payroll API)

zervant.note: SMB invoicing software (Espoo, Finland); Northzone and Conor led the EUR 4M Series A (the firm's post, 2016-08-16); acq. by Ageras Group, 2021 (the firm's post 2021-09-08; the Finnish register shows the entity as Ageras Oy, now Shine Europe Oy)

zettle.note: iZettle, mobile card payments (Stockholm); Northzone came in at the $31.4M Series B with Greylock (the firm's post, 2012-06-15; the founder: 'In the Series B round, Northzone came along'); acq. by PayPal, 2018 ($2.2B)

zopa.note: UK digital bank (founded 2005); Northzone's entry is the GBP 32m ($41.2M) round of June 2017 from Wadhawan Global Capital and Northzone, Jeppe Zink quoted (CNBC, 2017-06-02), a late round in a company whose 2021 round was its Series H: Growth; valued at about $1B in the GBP 68m round of Dec 2024 (aligned to Balderton's cited mark)
